title: 第一卷 第13章 刀起熊心烈第一卷 第14章 对峙
slug: 武道长生从猎户开始刷熟练度修行
lines: 夕阳西下，鹿鸣堡内逐渐热闹起来。
猎户、农夫陆续归家，炊烟袅袅升起，空气中飘散着饭菜香气与柴火味儿。
巷道间，孩童追逐打闹，妇人倚门唤儿，偶有犬吠鸡鸣，交织成堡内黄昏时分特有的嘈杂。
秦猛背弓挎刀，拎着沉甸甸的布袋，从后山小路悄然返回。
他有意避开人多处，专挑僻静巷道，在墙影间快速穿行。
很快，便到了自家那扇老旧木门前。
推门声惊动了屋里人。
沈秋月从里屋探出身，手里拿着件缝补一半的旧衣，见是秦猛，眉眼舒展开，放下针线迎上来：
“猛子，今日怎么……”
话到一半戛然而止，她脸色倏地白了。
秦猛身上的粗布猎装浸着大片血渍，袖口撕裂，虽已干涸，但那浓重的血腥气仍扑面而来。
“你受伤了？”
她急步上前，伸手要去查看。
“没受伤。”
秦猛握住她微凉的小手，撒了谎。
“是猎物的。”
沈秋月抬眼看他，见他气息平稳，心头稍安。
可看到衣服上几条平滑的豁口，眼神疑惑。
但她没有多问，只低声道：“先换下这身衣裳，我去烧水。”
“不急。”
秦猛反手关上门，将猎物放下，发出沉闷声响。
沈秋月这才注意到那袋子的丰硕，七八只山鸡野兔，还有只肥嘟嘟的狗獾，不禁轻呼：
“呀，这么多？”
秦猛随口应着，从怀中掏出一个鼓鼓囊囊的钱袋，哗啦啦倒在屋内唯一的木桌上。
他今天共收获九十八两七钱，外加两百多枚铜板。
银块和铜板堆成小堆，在昏黄天光下泛着诱人色泽。
沈秋月数了数掩住嘴，眼中满是惊诧。
她在堡内浆洗缝补，一月不过挣几百文，这些银钱对她而言，不亚于巨款，想都不敢想。
“猛子，这、这……”
“老天爷赏饭吃，碰上了值钱的大货。”
秦猛没多说，又从布袋子里取出油纸包来佐证。
当三层油纸揭开，那颗暗红色的妖心脏显露出来。
虽已离体多时，却仍温热，微微搏动，散发出浓郁的血煞之力。
沈秋月呼吸一窒，脸色煞白，下意识退后半步。
“这是熊心，这是熊胆。”
秦猛将熊心放在一旁，又取出腰间的竹筒，内里正是那颗金黄熊胆。
沈秋月见状，彻底相信，脸上露出如释重负的笑。
“这下家里的钱足够还债。”
“不着急还，等那厮来讨，我倒要看看他玩什么花样。”
content_en:
As the sun sets, Luming Fort gradually becomes lively.
Hunters and farmers are returning home one after another, smoke is rising, and the aroma of food and firewood is wafting in the air.
In the alleyways, children chase and play, women lean on the door to call for their children, and occasionally dogs bark and chickens crow, creating the unique noise in the castle at dusk.
Qin Meng returned quietly from the back mountain path with a bow and a sword on his back and a heavy cloth bag.
He deliberately avoided crowded places, chose secluded alleys, and walked quickly between the shadows of the walls.
Soon, I arrived in front of my old wooden door.
"Squeak——"
The sound of pushing the door startled the people in the house.
Shen Qiuyue leaned out from the back room, holding a half-patched old clothes in her hand. When she saw it was Qin Meng, her eyebrows widened, she put down her needlework and came forward:
"Mengzi, what happened today..."
She stopped abruptly in the middle of her words, and her face suddenly turned pale.
The coarse cloth hunting jacket on Qin Meng's body was soaked with large blood stains, and the cuffs were torn. Although it had dried, the strong smell of blood still hit his face.
"Are you hurt?"
She hurried forward and reached out to check.
"No injuries."
Qin Meng held her cold little hand and lied.
"It belongs to prey."
Shen Qiuyue raised her eyes to look at him and saw that his breathing was calm and she felt a little at ease.
You can see a few smooth gaps in the clothes, and his eyes are confused.
But she didn't ask any more questions, and just whispered: "Change out of these clothes first, and I'll boil the water."
"No rush."
Qin Meng closed the door with his backhand and put the prey down with a dull sound.
Only then did Shen Qiuyue notice the richness of the bag, including seven or eight pheasants, hares, and a plump dog and badger, and couldn't help but exclaim:
"Yeah, so many?"
"Yeah."
Qin Meng responded casually, took out a bulging money bag from his arms, and clattered it down on the only wooden table in the room.
He received a total of ninety-eight taels today, plus more than two hundred copper coins.
Silver nuggets and copper plates were piled in small piles, glowing attractively in the dim light.
Shen Qiuyue counted and covered her mouth, her eyes full of surprise.
She sewed and mended in the castle and earned only a few hundred coins a month. To her, this money was no less than a huge sum of money, which she couldn't even imagine.
"Mengzi, this, this..."
"God will reward you with food, and you will find something valuable."
Qin Meng didn't say much, and took out the oil paper bag from the cloth bag to prove it.
When the three layers of oil paper were peeled off, the dark red demon heart was revealed.
Although it has been out of the body for a long time, it is still warm and pulsating slightly, exuding strong blood evil power.
Shen Qiuyue's breath suffocated, her face turned pale, and she subconsciously took half a step back.
"This is the heart of a bear, this is the gall of a bear."
Qin Meng put the bear heart aside and took out the bamboo tube from his waist. Inside was the golden bear gallbladder.
When Shen Qiuyue saw this, she was completely convinced, with a relieved smile on her face.
"Now the family has enough money to pay off the debt."
"Don't be in a hurry to pay it back. When that guy comes to ask for it, I'd like to see what tricks he plays."
